seed_provenance.source: docs/research/retrospective-alpha-review.md:19-26 (per-regime WIN RATES used as relative weight priors; not Pearson ICs — see training_log/V222.md 'Seeding rationale')
seed_provenance.mapping: normal<-recent column, crisis<-crisis column, high_vol<-crisis column (stress proxy); trending column folded into pooled mean only
seed_provenance.defaults: 0.05 mild positive prior (Grinold-Kahn floor) for unmeasured signals; 0.0 for research-flagged dead weight (fear_greed_signal, ollivier_ricci_signal) -> excluded from weighting
seed_provenance.consumers: scripts/run_training.py V222 seed loader -> StrategyNode.update_signal_ics / update_regime_ics; the 'signals' key above remains the SignalDecayDetector observation store and is NOT read for seeding
